models.description: From-scratch chebyshev recurrent cop, 80% fixed-start episodes (cop_start/thief_start are SIGNED terms — the match always opens there). 0.9926 at scent=chebyshev/belief=prod on the FIXED-START harness (eval_candidate seed 20260810) vs 0.8704 for the random-start recipe and 0.2148 for the superseded book champion. Thief kept the random-start recipe (0.9741 beats fixed-start 0.9444). Serves as the hybrid_search BLIND-FRAME FALLBACK only — the minimax engine plays sighted frames.

BOOK-model (clamped wire law) fallback entry, added 2026-08-21 for book-scent pairings. This is the 2026-08-09 promoted wire-scent champion: trained with COPTHIEF_WIRE_SCENT=1 + COPTHIEF_UNIFORM_BELIEF=1, 0.6667 at scent=wire/belief=prod (eval_candidate). Under hybrid_search it is the BLIND-FRAME FALLBACK only: the sighted minimax reads book frames via the exact wire-law inverse (opponent_fix/scent_decoder), so this net plays only when the inverse is ambiguous.
